welcome.title: Welcome!
welcome.description: Let's learn the basics of Eureka Flow. We'll connect blocks and run a workflow together.

explore.title: Block Library & Canvas
explore.description: On the left is the Block Library. Two blocks are already on your canvas — let's connect them!

sidebar.title: Block Library
sidebar.description: On the left is the Block Library. Browse input, process, and output blocks, then click to add them to your canvas.

canvas.title: Workflow Canvas
canvas.description: This is your workspace. Two blocks are already placed — connect them by dragging between ports. Scroll to zoom, drag empty space to pan.

connect.title: Connect the blocks
connect.description: Drag from the blue dot (●) on the right side of "My First Input" to the blue dot on the left side of "Result".

run.title: Run it!
run.description: Click the ▷ play button on "My First Input" to execute. The result will appear in the Preview block.

done.title: You did it! 🎉
done.description: Get a free API key to save your work and use AI blocks.

welcome.title: Let's explore the editor!
welcome.description:
We'll take a quick tour of the workflow editor!
You can replay this tutorial anytime from the menu.

blockLibrary.title: Block Library
blockLibrary.description:
Click the block menu icon to open the Block Library!
Browse input, process, and output blocks, then drag or click
to add them to the canvas.

flowInfo.title: Flow Info & Status
flowInfo.description:
Check the flow name, save status, and connection status here.
Click the name to rename your workflow.

quickActions.title: Quick Actions
quickActions.description:
Save, undo, redo, and open the flow list.
You can also use keyboard shortcuts for quick access.

mainMenu.title: Main Menu
mainMenu.description:
File operations (export, import), editing tools (auto layout, reset),
publish, help, and more are available from the main menu.
Manage your Eureka API key in API Key Settings.

ready.title: All Set!
ready.description:
Start by adding blocks from the Block Library and connecting them!
You can always click Help in the main menu for guidance.

intro.title: How to Use Block Library
intro.description:
Before using Eureka Flow,
let us show you how to use the Block Library!

inputBlock.title: Input Block
inputBlock.description:
Blocks for entering data to send to AI, such as text and images.
Select an input block to add it to the canvas.

inputText.title: Input Block — Text Input
inputText.description:
Enter text in the text block to create results
like AI images or AI text.

processBlock.title: Process Block
processBlock.description:
Blocks that process input data with AI to generate results.
Select a process block to add it to the canvas.

processAiImage.title: Process Block — AI Image
processAiImage.description:
Connect to the 'Text Input' from the input block,
run it, and check the AI image result.

outputBlock.title: Output Block
outputBlock.description:
Blocks for previewing processed results or checking logs.
Select an output block to add it to the canvas.

outputPreview.title: Output Block — Preview
outputPreview.description: Preview the results from connecting input and process blocks.

help.title: Check the Help section for anything you're unsure about.

confirmDialog.title: Stop the block tutorial?
confirmDialog.description: You can revisit this from the main menu anytime.
